title: ModelaDB
description: ModelaDB is a browser-based editor for Chen-style and Crow's Foot ER/EER diagrams with rule-based validation and code generation for SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite), Laravel, Prisma, Django, GraphQL and JSON Schema.

creators.name: Garcias de Assunção, Willian
creators.affiliation: Federal University of Mato Grosso (UFMT), Department of Computing and Technology
